All cells ran successfully without errors. The fix worked. The issue was that the code was trying to create 14 subplots (7 cols × 2 rows) for a dataframe with 17 columns, so when the loop tried to access ax[14], it threw an IndexError.

By changing nrows from 2 to 3, we now have 21 subplots (7 cols × 3 rows), which is enough to accommodate all 17 columns.

Now I should submit the result.
